title: 26th sitting of the 20th Majlis

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamd and Salawat); the sitting begins.
Roll call of members present at the sitting.
Announcement of the day's agenda (Agenda No. އޖ/26/2024).

Question time: Galolhu North MP Mohamed Ibrahim asks Minister of Housing, Land and Urban Development Dr Ali Haidar Ahmed when plot boundaries will be marked and land handed over to those allocated land in Gulhifalhu, when plots given to Malé residents under the previous government's Binveriya scheme will be handed to their owners, and when the 4,000 flats under construction in Hulhumalé Phase 2 will be handed to successful applicants.
First reading of the Built Environment Planning and Management Bill, submitted on behalf of the government by Kolamaafushi MP Ibrahim Didi.
First reading of the Bill amending the Decentralisation Act (Law No. 7/2010), submitted on behalf of the government by Dhaandhoo MP Mohamed Fazeel.
Unfinished business: continued debate on the Insurance Bill, submitted on behalf of the government by Mahibadhoo MP Ahmed Thoriq.
Voting on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: The sitting questioned the housing minister on Gulhifalhu land, Binveriya plots and Hulhumalé flats, introduced two government bills and continued debating the Insurance Bill.
